name: 364-deepqueue-llama2-13b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Llama-2-13b-chat-hf -- an ungated re-upload of the gated meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-chat-hf, identical weights and config. ~26 GB of fp16 weights.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 4000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, sent to `/v1/completions` (`request_format`), so no chat template is applied. Prompt 112 +-96 tokens (16-512), generation 256 +-128 (32-512): a ShareGPT-shaped chat mix. `temperature: 0`. Seed 42.
purpose: A 13-billion-parameter chat assistant handling short single-turn prompts with 1024 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit ca4f1ab89c0c9bdd80fdfabcec52968fbde108bb (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.1.14-21-gca4f1ab89c0), launched by the interpreter named in `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested block is not read, and the engine then runs
# without what this file declares. This era's `launch_server` parses with `parse_args()`, which
# rejects unknown flags, so a key from a later sglang is a hard exit during bring-up.

model-path: NousResearch/Llama-2-13b-chat-hf
tp-size: 1
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
stream-interval: 1
random-seed: 42
